title: WaveAlign: Cache-Aware Query-Row Scheduling for Sparse Attention in Long-Video Generation
title_zh: WaveAlign: 缓存感知查询-行重排框架 for 动态稀疏注意

paragraphs.en: Long-video generation with diffusion transformers (DiTs) produces extremely long token sequences, making attention a dominant inference bottleneck. Dynamic sparse attention reduces computation, but its realized speedup remains limited because irregular query-row execution degrades L2 cache locality and increases HBM traffic.
paragraphs.zh: 基于扩散Transformer（DiT）的长视频生成会产生极长的token序列，使注意力机制成为主要的推理瓶颈。 动态稀疏注意力可以减少计算量，但由于不规则的查询行执行会降低L2缓存局部性并增加HBM流量，其实际加速效果仍然有限。

sents.en: Long-video generation with diffusion transformers (DiTs) produces extremely long token sequences, making attention a dominant inference bottleneck.

paragraphs.en: We present WaveAlign, a lightweight, cache-aware query-row reordering framework for dynamic sparse attention. WaveAlign formulates row ordering as an optimization problem and approximates it with two stages. The first stage derives a low-rank SVD representation of sparse-mask rows and groups query rows with similar K/V access patterns, increasing K/V overlap among concurrently scheduled rows. The second stage exploits streaming GPU scheduling by sorting rows within each wave in descending order of their K/V-block counts, so that short rows from the current wave are followed by long rows from the next. This aligns K/V accesses across wave boundaries and enables shared blocks to be reused before eviction. An adaptive skip module avoids unprofitable reordering. By only permuting query and mask rows, WaveAlign preserves sparse-attention semantics and requires no changes to existing methods or backend kernels. Across two GPU architectures, two video DiTs, and four sparse-attention methods, WaveAlign raises the L2 cache hit ratio from 28.48%–36.35% to 79.38%–89.06%, reduces HBM read traffic by up to 92.11%, and achieves up to 1.25 × 1.25\times kernel and 1.17 × 1.17\times end-to-end generation speedup without quality loss.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 WaveAlign，一个轻量级、缓存感知的查询行重排框架，用于动态稀疏注意力。 WaveAlign 将行排序形式化为一个优化问题，并通过两个阶段对其进行近似求解。 第一阶段对稀疏掩码行推导低秩 SVD 表示，并对具有相似 K/V 访问模式的查询行进行分组，从而提高并发调度的行之间的 K/V 重叠度。 第二阶段利用流式 GPU 调度，按 K/V 块数量的降序对每个波次内的行进行排序，使当前波次的短行后面紧跟着下一波次的长行。 这样可以在波次边界之间对齐 K/V 访问，并使共享块在被逐出之前得以复用。 一个自适应跳过模块可避免无益的重排。 由于仅对查询行和掩码行进行置换，WaveAlign 保留了稀疏注意力的语义，且无需对现有方法或后端内核做任何改动。 在两种 GPU 架构、两个视频 DiT 以及四种稀疏注意力方法上，WaveAlign 将 L2 缓存命中率从 28.48%–36.35% 提升至 79.38%–89.06%，将 HBM 读取流量最多降低 92.11%，并在不损失质量的情况下实现最高 1.25 × 1.25\times 的内核加速和 1.17 × 1.17\times 的端到端生成加速。

paragraphs.en: Diffusion transformers (DiT) has emerged as a dominant paradigm for high-fidelity video generation, for its strong scalability and high-fidelity synthesis capabilities [ 28 ] . Compared with image generation, video generation typically requires handling longer sequences, since the sequence length increases with both spatial resolution and the number of frames, so video generation remains very costly and time-consuming. The bottleneck mainly comes from the quadratic complexity in terms of input sequence length in the attention module [ 5 ] . For example, generating a 401-frame 720p video, corresponding to a 364K sequence length, takes 10,678 seconds using Wan2.1-14B [ 34 ] on a single NVIDIA H100 GPU, among which the attention accounts for 85.86%. Similar behaviors are also observed in LTX2.3 [ 21 ] and other video DiTs.
paragraphs.zh: 扩散 Transformer（DiT）凭借其强大的可扩展性和高保真合成能力，已成为高保真视频生成的主流范式 [ 28 ] 。 与图像生成相比，视频生成通常需要处理更长的序列，因为序列长度会随空间分辨率和帧数的增加而增长，因此视频生成仍然非常耗时且代价高昂。 瓶颈主要来自注意力模块中相对于输入序列长度的二次方复杂度 [ 5 ] 。 例如，使用 Wan2.1-14B [ 34 ] 在单块 NVIDIA H100 GPU 上生成一段 401 帧、720p 的视频（对应 364K 的序列长度）需要 10,678 秒，其中注意力部分占比高达 85.86%。 在 LTX2.3 [ 21 ] 及其他视频 DiT 中也观察到了类似的现象。

paragraphs.en: Utilizing the inherent sparsity of attention [ 16 , 18 , 42 , 49 ] , each query (block) only selects its most relevant KV (blocks) for attention calculation, which significantly reduces the attention computation while preserving generation quality. Nevertheless, in practice, the speedup brought by such sparse attention methods is far below the reduction in computation, even with GPU-optimized backend kernels such as FlashAttention4 [ 48 ] and FlashInfer [ 47 ] . Across Wan2.1 and LTX2.3, the speedup can only reach 80 % \% of the expected level. This gap reveals substantial untapped optimization potential in existing GPU implementations of sparse attention.
paragraphs.zh: 利用注意力固有的稀疏性 [16, 18, 42, 49]，每个查询（块）仅选择与其最相关的KV（块）进行注意力计算，在保持生成质量的同时显著降低了注意力计算量。 然而，在实际应用中，即使使用了FlashAttention4 [48]和FlashInfer [47]等针对GPU优化的后端内核，这类稀疏注意力方法带来的加速也远低于计算量的减少。 在Wan2.1和LTX2.3上，加速比只能达到预期水平的80% \%。 这一差距表明，现有稀疏注意力的GPU实现中还存在大量尚未开发的优化潜力。

paragraphs.en: Our profiling shows that this gap is fundamentally a memory-locality problem. Sparsification increases the L2 miss rate, collapses L2 cache reuse, and drives HBM bandwidth toward saturation, shifting attention from compute-bound to memory-bandwidth-bound execution. We trace this transition to two root causes of poor L2 cache locality. A wave comprises Q blocks executing concurrently across all GPU compute units, together with the K/V blocks they access. First, Q blocks in the same wave select spatially scattered, weakly overlapping K/V blocks, so their union overflows L2 cache and blocks are evicted before reuse. Second, Q blocks select different numbers of K/V blocks, creating workload imbalance that causes adjacent waves to interleave in execution, temporally misaligning accesses to shared blocks and extending their reuse distance.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的性能分析表明，这一差距本质上是一个内存局部性问题。 稀疏化提高了L2缺失率，破坏了L2缓存复用，并推动HBM带宽趋于饱和，使注意力计算从受计算限制转变为受内存带宽限制的执行。 我们将这一转变追溯到导致L2缓存局部性差的两个根本原因。 一个波（wave）由在所有GPU计算单元上并发执行的Q个块，以及它们所访问的K/V块组成。 首先，同一波中的Q个块会选择空间上分散、重叠度低的K/V块，因此它们的并集会超出L2缓存容量，导致块在复用之前就被逐出。 其次，不同的Q块会选择数量不同的K/V块，造成负载不均衡，使相邻的波在执行中交错，导致对共享块的访问在时间上错位，从而延长了它们的复用距离。

paragraphs.en: To address these problems, we present WaveAlign, a lightweight high-performance sparse attention framework. Note that the attention outputs w.r.t. the queries are computed independently. Through reordering the query rows, gathering the rows accessing similar KV blocks, WaveAlign improves L2 locality and hence improves the kernel efficiency. However, finding an effective row order is non-trivial. Existing locality-aware reordering methods for sparse matrix multiplication [ 17 , 1 , 4 , 43 ] cannot be directly applied to online sparse attention. Lower-cost methods provide little improvement in L2 locality, whereas methods that substantially improve locality incur preprocessing overhead that outweighs their kernel-time savings. A practical solution must capture similarities across irregular K/V access patterns and mitigate row-workload imbalance while providing reordering overhead from offsetting the resulting kernel gains.
paragraphs.zh: 为了解决这些问题，我们提出了 WaveAlign，一个轻量级高性能稀疏注意力框架。 注意，与查询相关的注意力输出是独立计算的。 通过对查询行进行重排序，将访问相似 KV 块的行聚集在一起，WaveAlign 提升了 L2 局部性，从而提高了内核效率。 然而，找到一个有效的行顺序并非易事。 现有的面向稀疏矩阵乘法的局部性感知重排序方法 [ 17 , 1 , 4 , 43 ] 无法直接应用于在线稀疏注意力。 低开销的方法对 L2 局部性的提升微乎其微，而能显著改善局部性的方法带来的预处理开销却超过了其在内核时间上的节省。 一个实用的解决方案必须能够捕捉不规则 K/V 访问模式之间的相似性，并缓解行负载不均衡，同时避免重排序开销抵消由此带来的内核收益。

paragraphs.en: To this end, WaveAlign proposes a cache-aware query-row reordering method, which cast row reordering as an optimization problem and approximate its solution with a lightweight two-stage algorithm. Exploiting the observation that similarities among irregular mask rows are low-rank, Stage 1 embeds the rows via a matrix-free rank-2 SVD [ 11 ] and orders them by polar angle, grouping rows with similar K/V-access patterns. Stage 2 then sorts rows within each wave by descending K/V-block count, so that short and long rows interleave across wave boundaries and shared K/V blocks are reused before eviction. The two stages are complementary: Stage 1 creates cross-row reuse opportunities and Stage 2 realizes them before cache eviction, jointly improving L2 locality. WaveAlign only permutes query and mask rows and restores the original output order, preserving sparse-attention semantics without modifying the sparse algorithms or backend kernels. Moreover, WaveAlign introduces an automatic discrimination mechanism that bypasses query-row reordering when the expected gain cannot amortize its overhead, such as for short sequences or highly sparse masks.
paragraphs.zh: 为此，WaveAlign 提出了一种缓存感知的查询行重排序方法，该方法将行重排序转化为一个优化问题，并用一个轻量级的两阶段算法来近似求解。 利用不规则掩码行之间相似度呈低秩的观察，第一阶段通过无矩阵的秩-2 SVD [11] 对行进行嵌入，并按极角对其排序，从而将具有相似 K/V 访问模式的行归为一组。 第二阶段随后在每个 wave 内按 K/V 块数量降序对行排序，使短行和长行在 wave 边界之间交错，从而让共享的 K/V 块在被逐出前得到复用。 这两个阶段互为补充：第一阶段创造跨行复用的机会，第二阶段在缓存被逐出前实现这些复用，共同提升 L2 局部性。 WaveAlign 仅对查询行和掩码行进行置换，并恢复原始输出顺序，在不修改稀疏算法或后端内核的情况下保持稀疏注意力的语义。 此外，WaveAlign 引入了一种自动判别机制，当预期收益无法抵消其开销时（例如短序列或高度稀疏的掩码），会跳过查询行重排序。

paragraphs.en: We implement WaveAlign in vLLM-Omni [ 32 ] and evaluate it on two GPU architectures, using FlashAttention4 as backend kernel on NVIDIA H100 and FlashInfer on NVIDIA A40. Our evaluation spans two widely used video DiT families, Wan2.1 [ 35 ] and LTX2.3 [ 21 ] , and four representative dynamic sparse-attention methods. Across these workloads, WaveAlign increases the L2 cache hit ratio from 28.48%–36.35% to 79.38%–89.06% and reduces HBM read traffic by 80.71%–92.11%, shifting sparse attention from the memory-bandwidth-bound regime back into the compute-bound regime. This improved memory efficiency yields up to 1.25 × 1.25\times kernel speedup, which translates into up to 1.17 × 1.17\times end-to-end generation speedup. Because WaveAlign preserves sparse-attention semantics, it maintains the same generation quality as the corresponding baselines.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 vLLM-Omni [ 32 ] 中实现了 WaveAlign，并在两种 GPU 架构上对其进行评估：在 NVIDIA H100 上使用 FlashAttention4 作为后端内核，在 NVIDIA A40 上使用 FlashInfer。 我们的评估涵盖两个广泛使用的视频 DiT 系列，即 Wan2.1 [ 35 ] 和 LTX2.3 [ 21 ]，以及四种具有代表性的动态稀疏注意力方法。 在这些工作负载上，WaveAlign 将 L2 缓存命中率从 28.48%–36.35% 提升至 79.38%–89.06%，并将 HBM 读取流量降低 80.71%–92.11%，使稀疏注意力从受内存带宽限制的状态重新回到受计算限制的状态。 这种内存效率的提升带来了最高 1.25 × 1.25\times 的内核加速，并转化为最高 1.17 × 1.17\times 的端到端生成加速。 由于 WaveAlign 保持了稀疏注意力的语义，它与相应的基线方法保持相同的生成质量。

paragraphs.en: Popular video DiTs share the same recipe. A video is encoded into a sequence of spatiotemporal tokens, whose length grows with both the frame count and the spatial resolution. Each Transformer layer applies multi-head attention (MHA) to capture dependencies across tokens, followed by a feed-forward network (FFN) [ 31 ] . MHA projects the hidden states X X into queries ( Q Q ), keys ( K K ), and values ( V V ), computes softmax-normalized query–key scores, and aggregates the values accordingly [ 31 ] . Unlike autoregressive large language models (LLMs), which restrict attention to preceding tokens with a causal mask, video DiTs apply full, non-causal self-attention over the entire sequence. Inference iteratively refines the latent noise over tens of denoising steps, each requiring a complete forward pass [ 13 ] . Because hidden states change at every step, the derived K/V tensors are transient and cannot be cached across steps, forcing full long-sequence attention to be recomputed throughout inference.
paragraphs.zh: 流行的视频 DiT 都遵循相同的方案。 视频被编码为一段时空 token 序列，其长度随帧数和空间分辨率的增加而增长。 每个 Transformer 层先应用多头注意力（MHA）来捕获 token 之间的依赖关系，随后接一个前馈网络（FFN）[ 31 ] 。 MHA 将隐藏状态 X X 投影为查询（Q Q）、键（K K）和值（V V），计算经过 softmax 归一化的查询–键分数，并据此聚合相应的值 [ 31 ] 。 与通过因果掩码将注意力限制在前序 token 上的自回归大语言模型（LLM）不同，视频 DiT 在整个序列上应用完整的、非因果的自注意力。 推理过程在数十个去噪步骤中迭代地精炼潜在噪声，每一步都需要一次完整的前向传播 [ 13 ] 。 由于隐藏状态在每一步都会变化，由此导出的 K/V 张量是瞬态的，无法跨步骤缓存，这迫使推理全程都要重新计算完整的长序列注意力。

paragraphs.en: Computation bottleneck of DiT. Despite their generation quality, DiTs are painfully slow. Using Wan2.1 T2V 1.3B [ 33 ] , a popular open source DiT model, generating an 81 frame video at a resolution of 720 × \times 1280 takes over five minutes on an H100 GPU. paragraphs.en: Our profiling shows that attention dominates the generation time, accounting for 73% and 90% in the two settings above. This overhead stems from the quadratic complexity of attention with respect to sequence length [ 5 ] . Video sequences are exceptionally long and grow with both frame count and spatial resolution, reaching 76K and 364K tokens in these settings. Moreover, bi-directional attention and iterative denoising incur this full quadratic cost at every layer and denoising step. Other popular video DiTs, such as LTX2.3 [ 21 ] , exhibit similar behavior. Therefore, reducing attention cost is essential for efficient long, high-resolution video generation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的性能分析显示，注意力在生成时间中占主导地位，在上述两种设置中分别占73%和90%。 这种开销源于注意力相对于序列长度的二次复杂度 [ 5 ] 。 视频序列异常长，且随帧数和空间分辨率的增加而增长，在上述设置中分别达到76K和364K个token。 此外，双向注意力和迭代去噪在每一层和每个去噪步骤中都会产生完整的二次开销。 其他流行的视频DiT，如LTX2.3 [ 21 ] ，也表现出类似的行为。 因此，降低注意力开销对于高效的长时长、高分辨率视频生成至关重要。

paragraphs.en: To mitigate the high cost of full attention, recent studies exploit the inherent sparsity of attention mechanisms [ 39 ] . Only a small subset of key/value tokens typically receives substantial attention weights and materially affects the output. Identifying these tokens and computing only the corresponding interactions can substantially reduce computation while preserving generation quality [ 30 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 为了缓解全注意力机制的高昂成本，近期研究利用了注意力机制固有的稀疏性 [ 39 ] 。 通常只有一小部分键/值词元会获得较大的注意力权重，并对输出产生实质性影响。 识别这些词元并仅计算相应的交互，可以在保持生成质量的同时大幅减少计算量 [ 30 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Consequently, recent works have increasingly favored dynamic-pattern methods, as important interactions vary across inputs. These methods estimate relevance from the online attention statistics and select important K/V tokens for each query at runtime, offering broader applicability and better accuracy preservation. MInference [ 16 ] instantiates head-specific A-shape, vertical-slash, or general sparse patterns; FlexPrefill [ 18 ] further adapts the pattern and budget to each input and head; XAttention [ 42 ] scores tokens via antidiagonal aggregation; and SpargeAttn [ 49 ] predicts relevance from pooled Q/K features and refines it via online softmax statistics.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，随着重要交互因输入而异，近期的研究工作日益倾向于动态模式方法。 这些方法在运行时从在线注意力统计中估计相关性，并为每个查询选择重要的K/V词元，从而具有更广泛的适用性和更好的精度保持能力。 MInference [ 16 ] 实例化了针对每个头的A形、垂直-斜线或通用稀疏模式；FlexPrefill [ 18 ] 进一步针对每个输入和每个头自适应地调整模式与预算；XAttention [ 42 ] 通过反对角线聚合对词元进行评分；SpargeAttn [ 49 ] 则从池化后的Q/K特征预测相关性，并通过在线softmax统计对其进行细化。

paragraphs.en: Block-sparse attention for modern GPUs. To exploit the GPU memory hierarchy as shown on the left of Figure 1 , memory accesses should be contiguous, while on-chip computation is naturally tiled over data blocks [ 5 , 6 ] . GPU-oriented dynamic sparse attention therefore organizes the Q Q , K K , and V V tensors and their computation at block granularity, with each block containing tens to hundreds of consecutive tokens.
paragraphs.zh: 面向现代 GPU 的块稀疏注意力。 为了充分利用如图 1 左侧所示的 GPU 存储层次结构，内存访问应当是连续的，而片上计算天然地以数据块为单位进行分块 [ 5 , 6 ] 。 因此，面向 GPU 的动态稀疏注意力以块为粒度来组织 Q Q 、K K 和 V V 张量及其计算，每个块包含数十到数百个连续 token。

A purple block with M i ​ j = 1 M_{ij}=1 denotes an executed interaction between Q i Q_{i} and ( K j , V j ) (K_{j},V_{j}) , while a white block with M i ​ j = 0 M_{ij}=0 denotes a skipped interaction. paragraphs.en: The query-row tasks concurrently occupying all SMs form a wave [ 24 ] . In the four-SM example in Figure 1 , rows 0–3 initially form wave 0, followed by rows 4–7 in wave 1. A wave is not a synchronization barrier. If row 2 finishes first because it accesses fewer K/V blocks, the freed SM immediately begins row 4 while the remaining rows of wave 0 continue. Because all SMs share the L2 cache, a K/V block loaded by one row can be reused by another if it remains resident in L2 cache; otherwise, it must be fetched again from HBM. The K/V access overlap, row workloads, and execution order therefore jointly determine the L2 cache hit ratio and HBM traffic.
paragraphs.zh: 同时占用所有 SM 的 query-row 任务构成一个波[24]。 在图 1 的四 SM 示例中，第 0–3 行最初构成波 0，随后第 4–7 行构成波 1。 波不是同步屏障。 如果第 2 行因为访问更少的 K/V 块而最先完成，被释放的 SM 会立即开始处理第 4 行，而波 0 的其余行继续执行。 由于所有 SM 共享 L2 缓存，某一行加载的 K/V 块若仍驻留在 L2 缓存中，就可以被另一行复用；否则必须再次从 HBM 获取。 因此，K/V 访问的重叠情况、各行的负载以及执行顺序共同决定了 L2 缓存命中率与 HBM 流量。

paragraphs.en: Sparse attention eliminates a substantial fraction of the FLOPs in dense attention, yet existing implementations often fail to achieve proportional speedups. We first quantify this gap, then show that sparsification shifts the kernel from compute-bound to memory-bandwidth-bound (Section III-B ), and finally identify two root causes (Section III-C ).

paragraphs.en: We evaluate four representative dynamic sparse-attention methods: MInference [ 16 ] , FlexPrefill [ 18 ] , XAttention [ 42 ] , and SpargeAttn [ 49 ] . We run them on two widely used video DiT models, Wan2.1-T2V-14B [ 34 ] and LTX2.3 [ 12 ] , using an NVIDIA H100 GPU with FlashAttention4 [ 48 ] as the backend kernel. The workloads span sequence lengths of 148K–364K tokens for Wan2.1 and 230K–401K tokens for LTX2.3; detailed setups are provided in Section VI-A . For each workload, ρ \rho denotes the retained block density, i.e., the fraction of non-skipped blocks among all dense-attention blocks. Executing a ρ \rho fraction of the blocks gives a compute-proportional upper-bound speedup of 1 / ρ 1/\rho . We measure the actual sparse-kernel speedup over the dense kernel as S actual S_{\mathrm{actual}} , and define the gap as ( 1 / ρ ) / S actual (1/\rho)/S_{\mathrm{actual}} .

paragraphs.en: To locate the source of the speedup gap, we profile the 364K-token Wan2.1 workload from Figure 2 using NVIDIA Nsight Compute (NCU) [ 26 ] . Table I reports each method’s default density ρ \rho , HBM bandwidth saturation measured as Speed of Light (SOL) [ 24 ] , and L2 hit ratio. The results show that sparsification degrades cache behavior. Dense attention achieves the highest L2 hit ratio and the lowest HBM SOL, because its regular K/V access stream enables effective cache reuse. All four dynamic sparse methods, in contrast, issue irregular and discontinuous K/V accesses, which substantially reduce L2 locality and drive up HBM SOL. Consistent with their smaller speedup gaps in Figure 2 , MInference and FlexPrefill retain more structured access patterns and therefore better L2 locality than XAttention and SpargeAttn. Finally, a synthetic random mask approximates the locality floor for fully unstructured K/V accesses, which XAttention and SpargeAttn already approach.
paragraphs.zh: 为了定位加速差距的来源，我们使用 NVIDIA Nsight Compute (NCU) [26] 对图 2 中 364K token 的 Wan2.1 工作负载进行性能剖析。 表 I 报告了每种方法的默认密度 ρ \rho、以光速 (Speed of Light, SOL) [24] 衡量的 HBM 带宽饱和度以及 L2 命中率。 结果表明，稀疏化会降低缓存行为。 稠密注意力实现了最高的 L2 命中率和最低的 HBM SOL，因为其规则的 K/V 访问流能够实现有效的缓存复用。 相比之下，所有四种动态稀疏方法都会发出不规则且不连续的 K/V 访问，这大幅降低了 L2 局部性并推高了 HBM SOL。 与图 2 中较小的加速差距一致，MInference 和 FlexPrefill 保持了比 XAttention 和 SpargeAttn 更结构化的访问模式，因而具有更好的 L2 局部性。 最后，合成随机掩码近似了完全非结构化 K/V 访问的局部性下限，而 XAttention 和 SpargeAttn 已经接近该下限。

paragraphs.en: To determine whether the increased HBM traffic shifts the kernel bottleneck from computation to memory bandwidth, we further conduct a roofline analysis [ 38 ] in Figure 3 . We estimate FLOPs from the two matrix multiplications in attention using the number of executed attention blocks and the per-block operation count. Kernel execution time and HBM traffic are measured directly with NCU tool. The achieved arithmetic throughput is calculated by dividing the estimated FLOPs by the measured kernel time, while operational intensity is calculated by dividing the estimated FLOPs by the measured HBM traffic. The compute roof corresponds to the theoretical FP16 peak throughput of H100. The results show that dense attention is compute-bound, whereas all sparse methods become memory-bandwidth-bound. Although sparsification reduces FLOPs, poor L2 locality prevents HBM traffic from decreasing proportionally, limiting kernel speedup and producing the gap observed in Figure 2 .
paragraphs.zh: 为了确定增加的 HBM 流量是否使内核瓶颈从计算转移到内存带宽，我们进一步在图 3 中进行了屋顶线分析 [38]。 我们利用已执行的注意力块数量以及每个块的操作数，从注意力中的两次矩阵乘法来估算 FLOPs。 内核执行时间和 HBM 流量直接用 NCU 工具测量。 实际算术吞吐量通过将估算的 FLOPs 除以测得的内核时间来计算，而运算强度通过将估算的 FLOPs 除以测得的 HBM 流量来计算。 计算屋顶对应于 H100 的理论 FP16 峰值吞吐量。 结果表明，稠密注意力受计算限制，而所有稀疏方法都变为受内存带宽限制。 尽管稀疏化减少了 FLOPs，但糟糕的 L2 局部性使 HBM 流量无法按比例减少，从而限制了内核加速，并产生了图 2 中观察到的差距。

paragraphs.en: Root cause 1: Spatially dispersed K/V accesses. Rows scheduled in the same wave share few K/V blocks, because dynamic masks assign each row an irregular access set (Figure 4 (a)). With little overlap, the SMs’ concurrent accesses span a large union of K/V blocks that overflows the working set of L2 cache. Useful blocks are evicted before they are reused, and each eviction converts a potential L2 hit into an extra HBM fetch.
paragraphs.zh: 根因 1：K/V 访问在空间上分散。 调度到同一波中的行几乎不共享 K/V 块，因为动态掩码为每一行分配了一个不规则的访问集合（图 4 (a)）。 由于重叠很少，各 SM 的并发访问覆盖了大量 K/V 块的并集，超出了 L2 缓存的工作集。 有用的块在被再次使用之前就被逐出，而每一次逐出都会把一次潜在的 L2 命中变成一次额外的 HBM 读取。

paragraphs.en: Root cause 2: NNZ-induced temporal misalignment. Even rows with overlapping access sets may fail to reuse shared blocks when their accesses are separated in time. As shown in Figure 4 (b), rows access different numbers of K/V blocks and therefore take different times to execute. Under streaming scheduling, an SM that finishes a shorter row immediately starts one from the next wave, temporally interleaving the two waves. This workload imbalance separates accesses to shared blocks. Although rows 4–7 all access the block pair ( K 6 , V 6 ) (K_{6},V_{6}) , they reach it far enough apart that the cached copy may be evicted between accesses, forcing repeated HBM fetches.
paragraphs.zh: 根本原因 2：NNZ 导致的时间错位。 即使两行的访问集合存在重叠，当它们的访问在时间上彼此分离时，也可能无法重用共享块。 如图 4 (b) 所示，各行的 K/V 块访问数量不同，因此执行所需的时间也不同。 在流式调度下，一个 SM 一旦完成较短的一行，就会立即开始下一波中的一行，从而使两波在时间上交错。 这种负载不均衡使对共享块的访问在时间上被分隔开。 尽管第 4–7 行都访问块对 ( K 6 , V 6 ) (K_{6},V_{6})，但它们到达该块对的时间间隔足够大，以至于缓存的副本可能在两次访问之间被逐出，从而迫使反复从 HBM 取数。

paragraphs.en: These two root causes jointly determine whether K/V reuse can occur. The sparse method fixes which K/V blocks each row needs, but not which rows run together or when they reach the shared blocks. Spatial overlap creates opportunities for cross-row reuse, while temporal alignment determines whether these opportunities can be realized before the blocks are evicted from L2. A failure in either condition leads to poor L2 cache locality and repeated HBM accesses.
paragraphs.zh: 这两个根本原因共同决定了 K/V 重用能否发生。 稀疏方法固定了每一行需要哪些 K/V 块，但没有固定哪些行一起运行，或者它们何时到达共享块。 空间重叠为跨行重用创造了机会，而时间对齐则决定了这些机会能否在这些块从 L2 中被逐出之前得到实现。 任一条件不满足都会导致糟糕的 L2 缓存局部性和重复的 HBM 访问。

paragraphs.en: As described in Section II-C , each query row is mapped to an SM, while rows in the same wave execute concurrently or in close temporal proximity and share the L2 cache. Meanwhile, query rows are mutually independent, allowing query and mask rows to be jointly reordered and their outputs restored afterward without changing attention semantics. Together, these observations enable us to group rows with overlapping K/V accesses into the same wave, increasing cross-SM L2 reuse and reducing HBM traffic.
paragraphs.zh: 如第II-C节所述，每个查询行被映射到一个SM，而同一波次中的行会并发或在时间上接近地执行，并共享L2缓存。 同时，查询行彼此独立，因此查询行和掩码行可以被联合重排序，并在 afterwards 恢复其输出，而不改变注意力语义。 综合这些观察，我们可以将具有重叠K/V访问的行分到同一波次中，从而增加跨SM的L2复用并减少HBM流量。

paragraphs.en: Building on this opportunity, we propose WaveAlign, a lightweight query-row scheduling framework. As shown in Figure 5 , the original workflow of sparse attention in the black path directly passes mask M M to the backend kernel. In contrast, WaveAlign introduces the red components as plug-in stages between mask construction and the backend kernel. Once receiving M M , WaveAlign first uses an adaptive guard to determine whether reordering is profitable (Section IV-E ). If reordering is skipped, the workload follows the original path. Otherwise, WaveAlign applies its two-stage row-ordering strategy to construct a reordered mask M ′ M^{\prime} (Section IV-C and IV-D ). After kernel execution, an inverse reorder restores the output rows to their original positions. Since each query row still attends to exactly the same K/V blocks, WaveAlign changes only the physical execution order and preserves both the semantics of sparse attention.
paragraphs.zh: 基于这一机遇，我们提出了 WaveAlign，一个轻量级的查询行调度框架。 如图 5 所示，黑色路径中稀疏注意力的原始工作流直接将掩码 M 传递给后端内核。 相比之下，WaveAlign 在掩码构建与后端内核之间引入了红色组件作为即插即用的阶段。 一旦接收到 M，WaveAlign 首先使用自适应守卫来判断重排序是否有收益（第 IV-E 节）。 如果跳过重排序，工作负载将走原始路径。 否则，WaveAlign 应用其两阶段行排序策略来构建重排序后的掩码 M′（第 IV-C 和 IV-D 节）。 内核执行完成后，逆重排序会将输出行恢复到其原始位置。 由于每个查询行仍然关注的 K/V 块完全相同，WaveAlign 只改变物理执行顺序，并保留稀疏注意力的语义。

paragraphs.en: However, realizing this workflow efficiently poses two challenges. First, the irregular masks generated by dynamic sparse attention make it difficult to efficiently identify rows with similar K/V access patterns. Second, reordering must incur low overhead, since it is repeatedly performed across attention heads, layers, and denoising steps and can otherwise offset the resulting kernel speedup.

paragraphs.en: The SVD-based ordering mentioned above (Stage 1) addresses spatially dispersed K/V accesses by grouping rows with similar access patterns. However, as discussed in Section III-C , it does not account for the varying numbers of nonzero blocks across rows. Figure 7 (a) illustrates 24 rows scheduled on 8 SMs over 3 waves. SM0–SM7 initially execute rows r 0 r_{0} – r 7 r_{7} , but rows with fewer NNZ blocks finish earlier and immediately fetch subsequent rows from the Wave 1. For example, after completing r 5 r_{5} and r 6 r_{6} , the corresponding SMs proceed to r 9 r_{9} and r 8 r_{8} , respectively. This progressive execution skew creates temporal misalignment across waves. Consequently, although Stage 1 places rows with overlapping K/V accesses close together, their accesses to the same blocks may occur far apart in time, weakening L2 cache reuse.

paragraphs.en: To mitigate this temporal misalignment, we first sort the rows within each Stage 1 Wave in descending order of NNZ blocks and then schedule them onto the SMs. As shown in Figure 7 (b), the first Wave assigns the longest row r 4 r_{4} to SM0 and the shortest row r 6 r_{6} to SM7. This long-short complementary assignment at successive Wave boundaries limits the accumulation of execution skew and keeps the SMs approximately aligned. Because rows in adjacent waves have similar K/V access patterns after Stage 1, temporal alignment allows their shared K/V blocks to be accessed within shorter reuse distances, thereby improving L2 cache locality.
paragraphs.zh: 为了缓解这种时间上的错位，我们首先将每个 Stage 1 Wave 内的行按 NNZ 块数量降序排列，然后将它们调度到 SM 上。 如图 7 (b) 所示，第一个 Wave 将最长的行 r 4 r_{4} 分配给 SM0，将最短的行 r 6 r_{6} 分配给 SM7。 在较短的行 r 5 r_{5} 和 r 6 r_{6} 完成后，其所在的 SM 分别获取下一个 Wave 中最长的行 r 12 r_{12} 和 r 11 r_{11}。 这种在相邻 Wave 边界上的长短互补分配限制了执行偏差的累积，并使各 SM 大致保持对齐。 由于经过 Stage 1 之后相邻 Wave 中的行具有相似的 K/V 访问模式，时间对齐使其共享的 K/V 块能够在更短的复用距离内被访问，从而提升 L2 缓存的局部性。

paragraphs.en: Two-stage coordination. Sections IV-C and IV-D improve L2 locality from complementary spatial and temporal dimensions, respectively. Algorithm 2 integrates the two stages. Given the sparse mask M M and wave size W W , WaveAlign reorders each attention head independently (Line 1). It first applies Stage 1 to derive a global row order based on K/V-access similarity (Lines 2–6), and partitions the ordered rows into wave-sized buckets (Line 7). Within each bucket, Stage 2 sorts rows by descending NNZ count to reduce cross-wave execution skew (Lines 8–12). Finally, the refined buckets are concatenated to produce the row permutation that can be directly scheduled by the backend kernel (Line 13).

paragraphs.en: Adaptive reordering skip. Row reordering is not always profitable, because its overhead must be amortized by the resulting kernel-time reduction. We skip reordering in three cases. First, for short sequences, the entire K/V working set fits in the L2 cache, making row order largely irrelevant to cache reuse. Second, when the mask is too sparse, the remaining attention workload is insufficient to amortize the reordering cost. Third, when adjacent rows already exhibit high K/V-access similarity, the original order provides adequate L2 locality. To make this decision automatically, our adaptive skip module extracts lightweight statistics from the sparse mask and combines them with offline profiles of kernel latency and reordering cost. Reordering is enabled only when the estimated latency reduction exceeds its overhead.
paragraphs.zh: 自适应重排跳过。 行重排并非总是有利，因为其开销必须由由此带来的内核时间缩短来摊销。 我们在三种情况下跳过重排。 首先，对于短序列，整个 K/V 工作集可以完全装入 L2 缓存，使得行顺序对缓存复用基本无关紧要。 其次，当掩码过于稀疏时，剩余的注意力计算工作量不足以摊销重排开销。 第三，当相邻行已经表现出较高的 K/V 访问相似度时，原始顺序已能提供足够的 L2 局部性。 为了自动做出这一决策，我们的自适应跳过模块从稀疏掩码中提取轻量级统计信息，并将其与内核延迟和重排开销的离线画像相结合。 只有当估计的延迟缩短超过其开销时，才启用重排。

The first implements the two-stage row reordering described in Algorithm 2 , applying the resulting permutation to the query blocks and sparse mask before attention kernel. The second applies the inverse permutation to restore the attention outputs to their original row order. Both operators are composed from PyTorch tensor primitives and registered in vLLM-Omni, allowing them to be invoked transparently throughout the inference pipeline.

paragraphs.en: FlashInfer per-head scheduling. On the A40 platform, we use FlashInfer [ 47 ] as the backend kernel. Its native scheduler prioritizes the K/V-head dimension, allowing Q-block computations from different heads to run concurrently across SMs. Because each head accesses a separate set of K/V blocks without cross-head overlap, concurrent execution only increases contention in the shared L2 cache. Following FlashAttention4 [ 48 ] , we instead prioritize the query-sequence dimension and execute K/V heads sequentially. This exposes only one head’s K/V working set at a time, reducing L2 contention and improving intra-head locality. Section VI-B and VI-C evaluate the effectiveness of this scheduling modification.
paragraphs.zh: FlashInfer 的逐头调度。 在 A40 平台上，我们使用 FlashInfer [ 47 ] 作为后端内核。 其原生调度器优先考虑 K/V 头维度，允许来自不同头的 Q 块计算跨 SM 并发运行。 由于每个头访问的是各自独立的一组 K/V 块，不存在跨头重叠，并发执行只会增加共享 L2 缓存中的争用。 借鉴 FlashAttention4 [ 48 ]，我们改为优先考虑查询序列维度，并按顺序执行 K/V 头。 这样每次只暴露一个头的 K/V 工作集，减少了 L2 争用并提升了头内的局部性。 第 VI-B 节和 VI-C 节评估了这一调度修改的有效性。

paragraphs.en: Hardware and software platforms. We evaluate WaveAlign on two NVIDIA GPU platforms. The H100 GPU provides 80GB of HBM3 memory and 50MB L2 cache shared by 132 SMs. The A40 GPU provides 48GB of GDDR6 memory and 6MB L2 cache shared by 84 SMs. The primary software stack includes CUDA 13.0 [ 25 ] , PyTorch 2.11 [ 29 ] , NsightCompute 2025.3.1 [ 26 ] , vLLM-Omni 0.20.0 [ 32 ] . paragraphs.en: Workloads. We use prompts from the Penguin Video Benchmark [ 15 ] to evaluate video generation. To construct workloads with different sequence lengths, we vary the number of frames while keeping the resolution fixed. For Wan2.1-T2V-14B, we use a resolution of 720 × 1280 720{\times}1280 and vary the frames from 161 to 481, yielding sequences of 148K–436K tokens. For LTX2.3-22B, the resolution is 1216 × 1920 1216{\times}1920 , and we vary the range of frames from 601 to 1401, yielding sequences of 173K–401K. For Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B, we set resolution as 720 × 1280 720{\times}1280 and frames from 121 to 241, yielding sequences of 112K–220K.

paragraphs.en: Baselines and configurations. Our baselines are four sparse-attention methods without applying WaveAlign under default sparse configurations: XAttention [ 42 ] with threshold 0.9, SpargeAttn [ 49 ] and MInference [ 16 ] with pre-autotuned config and FlexPrefill [ 18 ] with g = 0.60 g=0.60 . We use these configurations for the kernel-level evaluation of four methods. For the end-to-end evaluation, however, we exclude MInference and FlexPrefill because their overhead of mask construction is prohibitively high in our T2V workloads. For FlashAttention4 on H100, we use a block size of 128 × 128 128{\times}128 tokens and one resident cooperative thread array (CTA) per SM across 132 SMs, yielding a wave size of 132. For FlashInfer on A40, we use a block size of 64 × 64 64{\times}64 tokens and two resident CTAs per SM across 84 SMs, yielding a wave size of 168.
paragraphs.zh: 基线方法与配置。 我们的基线是四种在默认稀疏配置下未应用 WaveAlign 的稀疏注意力方法：阈值为 0.9 的 XAttention [42]、采用预自动调优配置的 SpargeAttn [49] 和 MInference [16]，以及 g=0.60 的 FlexPrefill [18]。 我们使用这些配置对四种方法进行算子级评估。 然而，在端到端评估中，我们排除了 MInference 和 FlexPrefill，因为在我们的 T2V 工作负载中，它们的掩码构建开销过高。 对于 H100 上的 FlashAttention4，我们使用 128×128 个 token 的块大小，并在 132 个 SM 上每个 SM 驻留一个协作线程阵列（CTA），从而得到 132 的波次大小。 对于 A40 上的 FlashInfer，我们使用 64×64 个 token 的块大小，并在 84 个 SM 上每个 SM 驻留两个 CTA，从而得到 168 的波次大小。

sents.zh: 我们的基线是四种在默认稀疏配置下未应用 WaveAlign 的稀疏注意力方法：阈值为 0.9 的 XAttention [42]、采用预自动调优配置的 SpargeAttn [49] 和 MInference [16]，以及 g=0.60 的 FlexPrefill [18]。

sents.en: We use these configurations for the kernel-level evaluation of four methods.
sents.zh: 我们使用这些配置对四种方法进行算子级评估。

sents.en: For the end-to-end evaluation, however, we exclude MInference and FlexPrefill because their overhead of mask construction is prohibitively high in our T2V workloads.
sents.zh: 然而，在端到端评估中，我们排除了 MInference 和 FlexPrefill，因为在我们的 T2V 工作负载中，它们的掩码构建开销过高。

sents.en: For FlashAttention4 on H100, we use a block size of 128 × 128 128{\times}128 tokens and one resident cooperative thread array (CTA) per SM across 132 SMs, yielding a wave size of 132.
sents.zh: 对于 H100 上的 FlashAttention4，我们使用 128×128 个 token 的块大小，并在 132 个 SM 上每个 SM 驻留一个协作线程阵列（CTA），从而得到 132 的波次大小。

sents.en: For FlashInfer on A40, we use a block size of 64 × 64 64{\times}64 tokens and two resident CTAs per SM across 84 SMs, yielding a wave size of 168.
sents.zh: 对于 A40 上的 FlashInfer，我们使用 64×64 个 token 的块大小，并在 84 个 SM 上每个 SM 驻留两个 CTA，从而得到 168 的波次大小。

paragraphs.en: Metrics. We report end-to-end generation latency and sparse-attention kernel latency, together with speedup relative to the corresponding baselines. We separately measure the total reordering overhead, including permutation construction, query and mask gathering, and inverse for output. To explain the latency reduction, we report L2 cache hit ratio and HBM read traffic. Finally, to verify that WaveAlign preserves the sparse-attention semantics and generated video quality, we report PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS, and the VBench [ 14 ] metrics Imaging Quality and Subject Consistency.
paragraphs.zh: 评估指标。 我们报告端到端生成延迟和稀疏注意力核延迟，以及相对于相应基线的加速比。 我们单独测量总的重排开销，包括置换构建、查询和掩码的收集，以及输出的逆变换。 为了解释延迟的降低，我们报告 L2 缓存命中率和 HBM 读取流量。 最后，为了验证 WaveAlign 保持了稀疏注意力的语义和生成视频的质量，我们报告 PSNR、SSIM、LPIPS 以及 VBench [14] 中的图像质量和主体一致性指标。

paragraphs.en: H100 results. Figure 8 reports the end-to-end video generation latency of XAttention and SpargeAttn with and without WaveAlign on Wan2.1-T2V-14B and LTX2.3-22B. In the original baselines, sparse attention dominates end-to-end latency, accounting for 65.8%–88.0% on Wan2.1-T2V-14B and 58.1%–84.4% on LTX2.3-22B. Consequently, WaveAlign’s kernel-level improvements translate into consistent end-to-end speedups across both models, both sparse-attention methods, and all evaluated sequence lengths, reaching up to 1.17 × 1.17\times on Wan2.1-T2V-14B and 1.14 × 1.14\times on LTX2.3-22B. The gains generally increase with sequence length because the growing K/V working set increasingly exceeds the fixed L2 cache capacity, leading to more severe cache thrashing and heavy HBM accesses under the original row order.
paragraphs.zh: H100 结果。 图 8 报告了 XAttention 和 SpargeAttn 在 Wan2.1-T2V-14B 和 LTX2.3-22B 上启用与不启用 WaveAlign 时的端到端视频生成延迟。 在原始基线中，稀疏注意力主导端到端延迟，在 Wan2.1-T2V-14B 上占 65.8%–88.0%，在 LTX2.3-22B 上占 58.1%–84.4%。 因此，WaveAlign 在内核层面的改进转化为在两个模型、两种稀疏注意力方法以及所有评估序列长度上一致的端到端加速，在 Wan2.1-T2V-14B 上最高达到 1.17 × 1.17\times，在 LTX2.3-22B 上最高达到 1.14 × 1.14\times。 收益通常随序列长度增加而提升，因为不断增长的 K/V 工作集越来越超出固定的 L2 缓存容量，导致在原始行顺序下出现更严重的缓存抖动和大量的 HBM 访问。

paragraphs.en: A40 results. Figure 9 reports the end-to-end generation latency of XAttention and Sparge on Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B under four configurations: FlashInfer’s native concurrent-head execution ( Original ), the sequential-head scheduler described in Section V ( O+Seq ), WaveAlign applied to the native scheduler ( O+WA ), and the combination of both optimizations ( O+Seq+WA ). Compared with Original , O+Seq alone achieves a speedup of up to 1.09 × \times , demonstrating the benefit of our sequential-head implementation. Applying WaveAlign directly to Original yields a speedup of up to 1.29 × \times . Combining the two optimizations further improves upon O+WA by up to 11.0%, with O+Seq+WA consistently achieving the lowest latency. The two optimizations improve cache behavior in complementary ways: sequential-head execution prevents different heads from simultaneously competing for the A40’s 6MB L2 cache, while WaveAlign further increases the L2 hit ratio by improving intra-head K/V reuse.

paragraphs.en: H100 results. Figure 10 illustrates the H100 sparse-attention kernel latency of MInference, FlexPrefill, XAttention, and SpargeAttn using real QKV tensors captured from Wan2.1-T2V-14B. Each WaveAlign bar separates the optimized kernel latency from the complete reordering overhead. Including this overhead, WaveAlign consistently outperforms the original kernel across all four methods and sequence lengths, achieving speedups of 1.092 × 1.092\times – 1.181 × 1.181\times for MInference, 1.088 × 1.088\times – 1.179 × 1.179\times for FlexPrefill, 1.124 × 1.124\times – 1.252 × 1.252\times for XAttention, and 1.125 × 1.125\times – 1.234 × 1.234\times for SpargeAttn. Reordering accounts for only 1.1%–3.2% of the total WaveAlign attention latency and is consistently outweighed by the kernel-time reduction.

paragraphs.en: A40 results. The A40 panels in Figure 10 report the kernel latency of the same four methods using real QKV tensors captured from Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B. We evaluate parallel- and sequential-head execution, each with and without WaveAlign, using FlashInfer’s native parallel-head scheduler as the baseline. The legend follows the naming convention in Section VI-B , and all reported WaveAlign speedups include the complete reordering overhead. Across the four sequence lengths, O+WA achieves maximum speedups over Original of 1.104 × 1.104\times , 1.090 × 1.090\times , 1.599 × 1.599\times , and 1.520 × 1.520\times for MInference, FlexPrefill, XAttention, and SpargeAttn, respectively. Relative to O+Seq , O+Seq+WA achieves maximum speedups of 1.133 × 1.133\times , 1.077 × 1.077\times , 1.614 × 1.614\times , and 1.556 × 1.556\times , respectively. Compared with Original , O+Seq+WA achieves maximum speedups of 1.158 × 1.158\times , 1.090 × 1.090\times , 1.635 × 1.635\times , and 1.601 × 1.601\times , and consistently provides the lowest total attention latency. WaveAlign improves both parallel- and sequential-head execution across all four methods, with its 7.5–29.7ms reordering overhead consistently outweighed by the kernel-time reduction. Sequential-head scheduling reduces cross-head L2 contention, while WaveAlign improves intra-head K/V locality, making O+Seq+WA the most effective configuration.

paragraphs.en: To identify the source of the kernel speedup, we use NVIDIA Nsight Compute (NCU) [ 26 ] to profile FlashAttention4 on H100 using a Wan2.1-T2V-14B workload with 401 frames at 720 × 1280 720{\times}1280 , corresponding to 364K visual tokens. In particular, XAttention and SpargeAttn have the lowest baseline hit ratios because their fully content-dependent masks produce more dynamic and irregular K/V access patterns. paragraphs.en: The two stages improve L2 reuse along complementary dimensions. Stage 1 groups rows with similar K/V access patterns into nearby waves, increasing the likelihood that different SMs request the same blocks. However, uneven row workloads can separate these requests in time and prevent cache reuse. Stage 2 sorts rows by descending NNZ to align CTA progress and shorten reuse distances, keeping shared K/V blocks in L2 for subsequent accesses. Stage 1 establishes spatial overlap, while Stage 2 converts it into temporal reuse; both are therefore necessary for effective L2 reuse.

paragraphs.en: Adaptive reordering skip. Figure 13 demonstrates the necessity of adaptive reordering proposed in Section IV-E by reporting kernel-level latency, including the reordering overhead, for XAttention on Wan2.1-T2V-14B with FlashAttention4. At short sequence lengths of 25K, 49K, and 98K, the kernel-time reduction is insufficient to amortize the reordering cost, so WaveAlign skips reordering and falls back to the default sparse-attention path, corresponding to a 1.0 × 1.0\times speedup over the baseline. From 197K onward, the growing K/V working set makes cache locality increasingly important, and reordering becomes profitable, delivering up to 1.18 × 1.18\times speedup. Retained density exhibits a similar trend: WaveAlign skips reordering at 1.7% and 6.7% density, but enables it from 14.5% onward, achieving 1.14 × 1.14\times – 1.20 × 1.20\times speedup. These results show that adaptive skipping prevents reordering overhead from causing regressions while preserving its benefits in profitable regimes.

paragraphs.en: Visualization of sparse mask. Figure 14 visualizes the head-0 sparse masks of XAttention and SpargeAttn on Wan2.1-T2V-14B before and after WaveAlign reordering. paragraphs.en: Compare with other reorder algorithms. Table II compares WaveAlign with four representative locality-aware sparse matrix multiplication reordering methods reviewed in Section VII , using the configuration in Section VI-D . These methods expose a trade-off between locality and overhead. Clustering has the lowest overhead among these baselines but barely raises the L2 hit ratio from 17.57% to 19.29%. Hypergraph, MinHash, and LSH substantially improve L2 locality, but their preprocessing costs outweigh the kernel savings, resulting in inference slowdowns. In contrast, WaveAlign raises the L2 hit ratio to 76.72% with only 19.85ms of overhead, retaining a 1.210 × 1.210\times net speedup. It is therefore the only evaluated method that combines effective locality improvement with practical online overhead.
paragraphs.zh: 与其他重排算法进行比较。 表 II 将 WaveAlign 与第七节中回顾的四种具有代表性的局部性感知稀疏矩阵乘法重排方法进行了比较，采用第六节 D 中的配置。 这些方法在局部性与开销之间存在权衡。 在这些基线中，聚类的开销最低，但仅将 L2 命中率从 17.57% 提升到 19.29%。 超图、MinHash 和 LSH 大幅改善了 L2 局部性，但其预处理成本超过了核函数带来的节省，导致推理速度下降。 相比之下，WaveAlign 仅以 19.85ms 的开销将 L2 命中率提升至 76.72%，保持了 1.210 × 1.210\times 的净加速。 因此，它是所评估的方法中唯一一个既能有效改善局部性、又具有可接受的在线开销的方法。

paragraphs.en: Sparse attention for video generation. This topic has attracted growing interest. Fixed-pattern methods reuse predefined layouts across inputs and denoising steps. Rule-based approaches, including LongNet [ 7 ] , LogSparse [ 19 ] , STA [ 51 ] , Radial Attention [ 20 ] , and LVSA [ 10 ] , exploit spatiotemporal locality, whereas profile-guided methods, such as SVG [ 39 ] and Sparse-vDiT [ 3 ] , select head- or layer-specific patterns from representative attention profiles. Content-adaptive methods , such as AdaSpa [ 40 ] and SVG2 [ 45 ] , identify important blocks or tokens from the current input to balance sparsity and generation quality. Complementary to these methods, WaveAlign reorders rows after mask construction to improve kernel efficiency without changing the selected blocks.
paragraphs.zh: 面向视频生成的稀疏注意力。 该主题引起了日益增长的关注。 固定模式方法在多个输入和去噪步骤中复用预定义的布局。 基于规则的方法，包括 LongNet [ 7 ]、LogSparse [ 19 ]、STA [ 51 ]、Radial Attention [ 20 ] 和 LVSA [ 10 ]，利用时空局部性；而基于画像引导的方法，如 SVG [ 39 ] 和 Sparse-vDiT [ 3 ]，则从代表性的注意力画像中选择特定于头或层的模式。 内容自适应方法，如 AdaSpa [ 40 ] 和 SVG2 [ 45 ]，从当前输入中识别重要的块或词元，以在稀疏性与生成质量之间取得平衡。 与这些方法互补的是，WaveAlign 在构建掩码之后对行进行重排，在不改变所选块的情况下提升算子效率。

paragraphs.en: GPU kernels for sparse attention. To accelerate attention, prior kernel optimizations fall into two groups. The FlashAttention series [ 5 , 6 , 48 ] improve kernel efficiency through IO-aware tiling, online softmax, and GPU pipelining. Sparse or flexible attention kernels, including FlashInfer [ 47 ] , FlexAttention [ 8 ] , FlashMask [ 36 ] , Block Sparse FlashAttention [ 27 ] , and FSA [ 44 ] , further support diverse sparse masks. WaveAlign complements these backends by reordering the mask to unlock their full performance.
paragraphs.zh: 用于稀疏注意力的 GPU 内核。 为了加速注意力计算，先前的内核优化分为两类。 FlashAttention 系列 [ 5 , 6 , 48 ] 通过 IO 感知的分块、在线 softmax 和 GPU 流水线来提升内核效率。 稀疏或灵活的注意力内核，包括 FlashInfer [ 47 ] 、FlexAttention [ 8 ] 、FlashMask [ 36 ] 、Block Sparse FlashAttention [ 27 ] 和 FSA [ 44 ] ，进一步支持多样化的稀疏掩码。 WaveAlign 通过重排掩码来释放这些后端的全部性能，与之形成互补。

paragraphs.en: Locality-aware sparse matrix reordering. Reordering is widely used to improve locality in sparse matrix multiplication, with representative approaches based on LSH-based row reordering [ 17 ] , hypergraph partitioning [ 1 ] , MinHash-based ordering [ 4 ] , and clustering [ 43 ] . However, our prior evaluation shows that the high preprocessing overhead makes them unsuitable for runtime-generated sparse attention masks. To the best of our knowledge, WaveAlign provides a fast and effective reordering method tailored to sparse attention.

paragraphs.en: WaveAlign is an efficient reordering framework for accelerating dynamic sparse attention in long-video generation. By jointly improving spatial KV locality and temporal workload alignment, it increases L2 cache reuse and reduces HBM traffic without modifying the sparse attention algorithm. WaveAlign reduces end-to-end video generation latency by up to 1.17× and sparse attention latency by up to 1.25× over strong baselines across multiple models and algorithms.
paragraphs.zh: WaveAlign 是一个用于加速长视频生成中动态稀疏注意力的高效重排序框架。 通过同时改进空间 KV 局部性和时间负载对齐，它在不修改稀疏注意力算法的情况下提高了 L2 缓存复用率并减少了 HBM 流量。 在多个模型和算法上，与强基线相比，WaveAlign 将端到端视频生成延迟降低了最高 1.17 倍，将稀疏注意力延迟降低了最高 1.25 倍。
